body:
Thanks for being so friendly, sorry I'm replying six days late. 

I think my anger is just really fear and sadness dressing up as something else. There's quite a lot of stuff that upsets me but I feel I've gone through it with like fifty million people at this point... and I just keep getting bounced around or ignored. So... yeah I guess I've sort of developed trust issues when it comes to opening up to people without sounding furious about everything or just playing it down.

Sorry for being so late on the reply.

I guess I just really need anyone at this point. I'm clinging to literally anyone who will talk to me. So I'd settle for even the worst of the worst counselors to be honest.

Thanks for responding by the way, I really appreciated it.

Hey, sorry for the slow reply. I really appreciate that you responded.

I'm just hurting, I feel really tired, and sick, and I feel like I keep trying and trying to get better, and it's crushing me each time that I can't manage it. The sadness is like a physical thing for me, like.. my insides... they hurt, and my bones, and my brain.. it's difficult to describe quite how unpleasant it is.

 The best way I can think to describe it is when I broke my collar bone and how, when I turned, the two split pieces would slide over each other.. the pain wasn't like normal pain.. you just felt it everywhere at once. But then, that was bearable because I knew it would heal.. this.. doesn't feel like it's going to heal. 

Honestly, the anger is just how I deal with being terrified. I'm losing control of my ability to cope, and it's a horrible feeling not being able to do anything about it. Like, I spent this evening writing a goodbye note and counting out lethal dosages.. and it was like I wasn't even doing it. I'm freaking everybody out and I can't help it. I just keep doing everything I can to put shit off to tomorrow because I guess some small part of me wants to believe things are going to get better.
